issue.title: Fix the Maestro images fullscreen smoke selector [Viewing and listening to resources Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the viewing and listening to resources audit (#531, epic #526).

**Severity:** Low (test infra)  
**Launch blocker:** No  
**Confirmed on:** file inspection on `main` @ `fb634e5`

## Summary
`.maestro/flows/drafting/images-fullscreen.yaml` waits for `images-maps-thumbnail-.*`, a testID that no longer exists (thumbnails use `images-maps-item-*` and `images-maps-maximize-*`). The step is conditional, so the flow passes without ever opening fullscreen.

## Expected
The smoke flow opens a thumbnail in fullscreen and closes it when an image is available.

## Actual
The fullscreen branch never runs.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Compare the selectors in `.maestro/flows/drafting/images-fullscreen.yaml` with the testIDs in `src/app/tabs/resources/ImageThumbnail.tsx`.
2. Run `npm run maestro:test:drafting` on a verse with images: the flow passes without opening fullscreen.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Flow targets `images-maps-maximize-.*`.
- [ ] Flow uses a fixture verse known to have images so the branch is not optional.
- [ ] `npm run maestro:test:drafting` passes on the emulator.

## Related
- #191, #491 / PR #501
- Parent audit: #531 (epic #526)
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/viewing-and-listening-to-resources/README.md` (PR #590)
